purpose: Guarantee that Structure input roles read disjoint source scopes and that every writable output is isolated from all inputs.

model.inputs: One or more strictly read-only input scopes. Each input has an explicit repository and, when sharing a repository with another input, an explicit directory scope.
model.output: A writable repository and/or directory used for generated CW, mappings, plans, reports, exports or other Structure artifacts.

invariants: Structure MUST NOT write, modify, delete, commit, generate or persist anything inside an input scope.
Different logical input roles MUST NOT read the same repository scope or overlapping directory scopes.
Specification input and implementation/code input MUST be disjoint.
Two inputs MAY use the same repository only when both declare explicit directory scopes and those resolved directory trees do not overlap.
If two inputs reference the same repository and either input omits its directory scope, the configuration MUST fail.
If two input directory scopes are identical, the configuration MUST fail.
If one input directory is inside another input directory, the configuration MUST fail.
Sibling or otherwise disjoint directory scopes inside the same repository are allowed.
The output MUST be validated against every input before the first write.

If output.repository resolves to the same repository identity as any input.repository, output MUST declare a directory scope and that scope MUST be disjoint from every input directory scope in that repository.
If output and an input share a repository and either side lacks an explicit directory scope, the configuration MUST fail.
If output.directory is identical to, inside, or contains any input.directory, the configuration MUST fail.
Repository aliases, URL forms, trailing .git suffixes and case differences MUST be normalized before comparison where the repository scheme permits it.
Filesystem paths MUST be expanded and resolved to canonical real paths before comparison.
Symbolic-link and relative-path aliases resolving to overlapping directory trees count as overlap.
There is no override, force flag, confirmation mode or privileged bypass for these invariants.
Failure MUST occur before parsing writes, mapping persistence, generated CW, reports, exports or any other target mutation.

allowed: repo/spec/ as specification input and repo/src/ as code input
separate repositories for specification and code
forbidden: repo/ as specification input and repo/src/ as code input
repo/spec/ as both specification and code input
same repository for specification and code without explicit directory scopes

input_overlap.message: Structure input scopes must not overlap. Inputs sharing a repository require explicit disjoint directory scopes.

output_overlap.message: Structure output must be isolated from every read-only input scope.
